lessons_used: Sign-in: Post-adoption timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; reordering sign-in elsewhere and adding sync or safety notices showed no clear effect.

Choose Path: Headline updates emphasizing clarity/value, spotlight layouts, visual stage redesigns, and outcome clarity tips won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, and reassurance notes hurt, while simplified copy showed no clear effect.
Home: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; progress trackers, sound alerts, completion timers, and compatibility checks showed no clear effect.

Adoption: Photo quality guide previews and split preview layouts won; compact grids, guidelines banners, mascot stamps, fallback flows, spotlight selection views, and multi-step inspection flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews and incentives showed no clear effect.

Finish: Interactive spawn placement flows, placement verification screens, and tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while docking hints and welcome redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions: Underpredicted gains on counter-intuitive flow additions (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted performance on severe flow failures (such as mascot stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, and guided spawn stages).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Inspection Stage
candidates.change: Adds a photo quality verification stage right after uploading custom pet photos to confirm facial framing and lighting before adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off (68.9% conversion) and support received multiple emails about failed custom pet generations.

new_photo_inspection.headline: Photo Quality Verification
new_photo_inspection.body: Ensure your pet's face is clear and evenly lit for the best 3D desktop render.

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality inspection stage inside onboarding is permitted and preserves all required steps and screen functions.

candidates.score_note: Multi-step inspection flows hurt adoption conversion despite high drop-off.

candidates.title: Account Data Match Security Notice
candidates.change: Displays a clear sign-in reassurance hint explaining how signing in syncs existing pet profile data to prevent pet loss.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account to automatically restore and sync your existing pets.

guard.reason: Adding reassurance copy and badges to the sign-in screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Safety and sync notices show minimal performance gains on sign-in.

candidates.title: Desktop Background Readiness Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split stage layout displaying desktop background render progress and ready status.
candidates.why: The home stage takes a long time (mean 2336s), causing users to close or abandon the app during rendering.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Spawn

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen while retaining its core function of showing that the pet is being made is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Readiness status checks and waiting screen redesigns consistently win.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Control Placement Verification Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated desktop control check screen after onboarding welcome explaining system tray controls and desktop mascot visibility.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets mentioned confusion over how to talk to, hide, or control the pet after finishing onboarding.

new_tray_verification.headline: Pet Desktop Controls Ready
new_tray_verification.body: Look for your pet icon in the system tray to adjust companion visibility and controls anytime.

guard.reason: Adding new onboarding screens after the home intro overlay is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Placement verification screens are proven counter-intuitive winners.

candidates.title: Story Value Experience Split Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the intro story screen into a split view layout showing interactive pet desktop features alongside value narrative.
candidates.why: Choose path has high mean completion times (514s), requiring stronger visual clarity early in the flow.

story.headline: Meet Your Desktop Pet Companion
story.body: Adopt, customize, and interact with your companion directly on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen while continuing to introduce the pet companion preserves its required job.

candidates.score_note: Visual stage redesigns and split layouts increase early path clarity.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Loss Prevention Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly instruct returning users to sign in with their original account to preserve pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) was users losing pets due to logging in with wrong accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Please use the sign-in method linked to your original adoption to preserve your pet data and progress.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Account recovery copy updates consistently improve sign-in retention.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Headline Refresh
candidates.change: Updates photo upload screen headline and body text with explicit photo lighting and framing requirements.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences the highest drop-off rate (68.9% conversion) and custom pet creation bug reports.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Bright, High-Contrast Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: For best mascot generation results, upload a photo with clear facial lighting and a distinct background.

guard.reason: Updating photo upload instructions inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Photo quality guidance headlines win without adding flow friction.

candidates.title: Background Hatching Time Estimate Indicator
candidates.change: Enables duration time estimates and progress indicators on the home waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336 seconds, leaving users uncertain about background activity.

waiting.hint: Generation usually takes 3 to 5 minutes. Feel free to minimize this window while you wait.

guard.reason: Showing time estimates for a real wait duration on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Progress indicators on home show modest positive gains.

candidates.title: System Tray Desktop Companion Control Tip
candidates.change: Adds a persistent system tray control shortcut tip on the finish welcome screen.
candidates.why: Users wrote support mails confused about how to hide, show, or control their desktop pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to toggle mascot visibility or access pet controls.

guard.reason: Adding system tray tips to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Notification control tips at finish step historically reduce completion.

candidates.title: Path Selection Starter Companion Perks Badge
candidates.change: Adds a starter companion perks badge to the path selection screen to increase user motivation.
candidates.why: Path selection mean duration is 514s, indicating initial hesitation before choosing a route.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'Free Starter Item Set', violating rule 3 which prohibits mentioning free extras, gifts, discounts, or prices during onboarding.

lessons_next: Sign-In: Post-adoption placement, pet recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; reordering sign-in elsewhere hurt or had no clear effect, while sync safety notices showed no clear effect.

Choose Path: Clarity and value headlines, visual stage redesigns, spotlight layouts, and outcome clarity tips won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, and reassurance notes hurt, while simplified copy had no clear effect.

Home: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness status checks, and desktop spawn hints won; progress trackers, sound alerts, completion timers, readiness redesigns, and compatibility checks had no clear effect.

Adoption: Photo quality guide previews and split preview layouts won; compact grids, guideline banners, mascot stamps, fallback flows, spotlight views, and multi-step inspection flows hurt; pre-adoption reviews and incentives showed no clear effect.

Finish: Interactive spawn placement flows, placement verification screens, and tray location tips won; direct control guides, guided spawn stages, and first-interaction tips hurt; welcome stage redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions: Underpredicted gains on added flow steps (like placement verification screens and spawn flows), while overpredicting performance on severe flow disruptions (like mascot stamps, direct control guides, and guided spawn stages).
